fact: The Meteo Rwanda presentation at EUMETSAT lists PUMA-2025 reception stations and MTG data among its observing infrastructure, states ISO 9001:2015 certification, and gives severe thunderstorm warning lead time rising from 15 minutes in 2021 to a projected 60 minutes in 2026.
title: Weather from Space A Game Changer for Africa: The use of MTG and radar at Meteo Rwanda
publisher: Rwanda Meteorology Agency (Meteo Rwanda), presented at EUMETSAT
